nodes.label: SOAP Optimizer
nodes.rationale: Second-order optimizer using Shampoo-style Kronecker factors with KL divergence regularization for improved numerical stability in large-batch LLM pretraining

nodes.label: Muon Optimizer
nodes.rationale: Matrix-based optimizer using Newton-Schulz orthogonalization for weight updates, designed for efficient large-batch training

nodes.label: KL-Shampoo
nodes.rationale: Gradient covariance estimation via Kullback-Leibler minimization that reduces condition number of Kronecker factors to square root of standard formulation, improving numerical stability

nodes.label: Slingshot Instability
nodes.rationale: Early-training instability in large-batch pretraining caused by stale preconditioner effect when eigenbasis updates lag behind rapidly changing loss landscape

nodes.label: Layer-Wise Distributed Optimizer
nodes.rationale: System-level implementation strategy in Megatron-LM that maintains 2D weight matrices intact across distributed training while using variable-sized allgather collectives for parameter synchronization

nodes.label: Qwen-3-30B-A3B Architecture
nodes.rationale: MoE architecture used for large-scale comparative studies of SOAP and Muon optimizers

nodes.label: Momentum Orthogonalized by Polar (MOP)
nodes.rationale: Variant of Muon that replaces Newton-Schulz orthogonalization with exact polar decomposition via SVD

nodes.label: QR Decomposition for Eigenbasis
nodes.rationale: Per-step QR decomposition in SOAP to recompute eigenbasis, critical for resolving slingshot instability in large-batch training

nodes.label: SOAP, Muon, and Beyond: Pushing LLM Pretraining Scales
nodes.author: Mikail Khona et al., NVIDIA
nodes.rationale: Addresses scalability of higher-order optimizers (SOAP, Muon) for LLM pretraining. Identifies instabilities in SOAP at large batch sizes, proposes fixes, and demonstrates both optimizers outperform AdamW at extreme batch sizes (up to 100M tokens).

nodes.label: Muon Optimizer
nodes.rationale: Spectral optimizer: applies momentum then orthogonalizes via Newton-Schulz iterations to approximate polar factor. Lower memory footprint than SOAP; maintains training stability at large batch sizes where AdamW degrades.

nodes.label: SOAP Optimizer
nodes.rationale: Tensor-wise adaptive method: combines Shampoo-style preconditioning with Adam-like element-wise updates in preconditioner eigenbasis. Rotates gradients into eigenbasis, applies adaptive update, rotates back. Larger memory footprint than Muon.

nodes.label: AdamW Optimizer
nodes.rationale: Element-wise adaptive optimizer: maintains EMA of gradient and squared gradient per parameter. Memory-regular and easily shardable but ignores matrix structure of weights. Hits critical batch size beyond which performance degrades.

nodes.label: Update RMS Matching Framework
nodes.author: Kimi-Moonshot
nodes.rationale: Fair learning rate transfer across optimizers by ensuring root mean square norm of parameter updates is consistent. Enables direct comparison of SOAP, Muon, AdamW without hyperparameter tuning.

nodes.label: Batch Size Scaling for MoE Models
nodes.rationale: MoE expert parameters see reduced effective batch size due to sparse top-k routing. For top-8 routing over 256 experts: B_eff^expert / B_global = 0.03125. Dense parameters must handle full global batch, making them optimization bottleneck.

nodes.label: Square Root Scaling Rule
nodes.rationale: Learning rate adjustment for batch size changes: η' = η√(B'/B). Preserves variance scale of parameter updates when scaling batch size. Safer than linear scaling for large leaps in batch size.

nodes.label: Layer-Wise Distributed Optimizer
nodes.rationale: Distributes different layers to different DP ranks so each GPU has full layers' worth of parameters. Enables preconditioner calculation for matrix-based optimizers without additional communication. Compatible with Megatron-LM.

nodes.label: SOAP Instability Fix at Large Batch Sizes
nodes.rationale: Identified lag between preconditioner and current gradient statistics causing loss spikes. Solution: per-step QR orthogonalization, improved preconditioning strategies, KL-divergence-based covariance estimation for Kronecker factors. Eliminates instability.

nodes.label: Nemotron-3 Dataset
nodes.rationale: 1T- and 3T-token subsets used for optimizer experiments. Enables evaluation of convergence and stability across different training horizons.

nodes.label: Emerging-Optimizers Library
nodes.author: NVIDIA
nodes.rationale: Open-source codebase implementing SOAP, Muon, AdamW and variants. Includes layer-wise distributed optimizer compatible with Megatron-LM. Supports research community.

nodes.label: Shampoo Optimizer
nodes.rationale: Precursor to SOAP: maintains Kronecker-factored gradient statistics for each tensor dimension. Approximates second-order information via row/column covariance matrices. Foundation for modern tensor-wise adaptive methods.

nodes.label: Newton-Schulz Iteration
nodes.rationale: Matrix polynomial iteration to compute polar factor (closest orthogonal matrix). Used in Muon for orthogonalization. Approximates SVD polar factor U V^T without explicit eigendecomposition.

nodes.label: MoE Configuration for Experiments
nodes.rationale: Nemotron-3-72B-A8B: 512 total experts, top-6 routing, 5376 shared expert size. Qwen3-30B-A3B: 128 experts, top-8 routing. Load-balancing via sigmoid score + sequence-level auxiliary loss (coeff 1e-4).

nodes.label: Batch Size Ramp-Up Schedule
nodes.rationale: Early training phase: double batch size every S steps over N total steps until target reached. Learning rate warmup tied to batch size ramp-up to maintain η ∝ √B. Enables Muon to significantly outperform AdamW at larger batches.
